dialogues.speaker: Diminished Seventh Arpeggio
dialogues.text: Ooh, looks like everyone's happy with the results of the competition. Time for me to head back to work.

dialogues.speaker: Diminished Seventh Arpeggio
dialogues.text: Life is unpredictable, and no one knows what the future holds... Maybe one day, if I get fired from the Fatui and you have your own team... I might just come join you?

dialogues.speaker: Diminished Seventh Arpeggio
dialogues.text: If that time ever comes, I hope you won't turn me away for being too weak.
